title: Interpret Container Selection screen: container/total ID and tote presence color coding
summary: Use the Container Selection screen to identify the selected container/total ID (e.g., the “113”) and determine whether a rack location has a tote by using the dark-blue vs light-blue color indicators. If you select a dark-blue (tote-present) cell, the screen shows a box icon and the tote number.
when_to_use: When you need to read the Container Selection screen to confirm which container/total ID is selected and whether a rack location is tote-present (dark blue) or empty (light blue), including verifying the tote number after selecting a tote-present cell.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Container Selection screen and interpret the container/total ID and tote-present/empty color coding to report the tote status for a specific rack location.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the screen’s container/total ID and dark-blue/light-blue indicators

access_required: Access to the Container Selection HMI screen
system_preconditions: Container Selection screen is available and displaying container/total IDs and rack/location cells with dark-blue vs light-blue indicators

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing: green container/total ID (example “113”), and dark-blue (tote present) vs light-blue (empty rack) meaning.

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen (Container Selection 1 / Totes / Container / Location)
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that displays the container/total ID and the rack/location tote color indicators.
steps.instruction: Open the Container Selection screen that shows Container Selection 1 / Totes / Container / Location.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is visible with rack/location cells that use dark-blue vs light-blue to indicate tote presence vs empty rack, and with a green container/total ID field.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the green container/total ID and the dark-blue/light-blue indicators on rack/location cells.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not display the container/total ID in green or the rack/location cells do not show dark-blue vs light-blue indicators.

actions.label: Open Container Selection screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Container Selection screen (the screen described as showing Container Selection 1 / Totes / Container / Location).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Container Selection screen cannot be opened or the expected container/total ID and color indicators are not visible, stop and escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Container Selection screen shows the “113 in that green is the container” and “the 113 is the total number/total ID”; dark blue indicates tote presence while light blue represents empty rack.

steps.title: Read the green container/total ID (e.g., “113”)
steps.purpose: Identify the selected container/total ID shown in green on the Container Selection screen.
steps.instruction: Locate the green number labeled as the container/total ID and note its value (example given: “113”).
steps.expected_result: You can identify the green container/total ID value (example: “113”) and treat it as both the container and the total number/total ID as described.
steps.healthy_condition: The green container/total ID is clearly visible and matches the described meaning (container/total ID).
steps.failure_condition: The green container/total ID is missing, unreadable, or does not appear to match the described container/total ID field.

actions.label: Identify green container/total ID
actions.exact_action: Locate the green number labeled as the container/total ID (the source states the “113 in that green is the container” and “the 113 is the total number/total ID”).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the screen does not show the expected green container/total ID, stop and escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The ‘113 in that green is the container’” and “the 113 is the total number/total ID.”

steps.title: Determine tote presence vs empty rack using dark-blue vs light-blue
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the rack/location cell has a tote based on the color indicator.
steps.instruction: At the rack/location cell you care about, check the color indicator: dark blue means tote present; light blue means empty rack.
steps.expected_result: You can classify the rack/location as tote-present (dark blue) or empty (light blue) using the screen’s color coding.
steps.healthy_condition: Dark-blue cells correspond to tote-present locations; light-blue cells correspond to empty rack locations.
steps.failure_condition: The color indicator meaning cannot be applied because the cell colors/states do not match the described dark-blue vs light-blue tote presence vs empty rack mapping.

actions.label: Check cell color indicator
actions.exact_action: Confirm whether the rack/location cell is dark blue (tote present) or light blue (empty rack).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the color indicator meaning cannot be applied (colors/states differ from the source’s dark-blue vs light-blue meaning), stop and escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Dark blue indicates tote presence while light blue represents empty rack.”

steps.title: Select the dark-blue (tote-present) cell to reveal box icon and tote number
steps.purpose: Expose the tote number details for a tote-present rack/location cell.
steps.instruction: If needed, select the dark-blue cell (tote-present rack/location) and observe whether a box icon appears and whether the tote number is shown.
steps.expected_result: After selecting a tote-present (dark-blue) cell, a box icon appears and the tote number is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: Selecting a dark-blue cell results in a box icon and a tote number being shown on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting a dark-blue cell does not show a box icon or does not display a tote number.

actions.label: Select the tote-present cell
actions.exact_action: Select the dark-blue/light-blue cell and observe whether a box icon appears and whether the tote number is shown.

stop_or_escalate_if: If selecting the cell does not reveal the box icon and tote number as described, stop and escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “If you select it, a box icon will show … as well as the tote number.”

steps.title: Report what the screen indicates for that location (container/total ID and tote presence)
steps.purpose: Provide a clear support-facing interpretation of the Container Selection screen for the specified rack/location.
steps.instruction: Using the green container/total ID value and the dark-blue vs light-blue tote presence classification, report what the screen indicates for that location. If you selected the tote-present cell, include the tote number shown with the box icon.
steps.expected_result: You can state: (1) the green container/total ID value (example “113”), and (2) whether the rack/location is tote-present (dark blue) or empty (light blue), and (3) the tote number if the box icon/tote number was revealed after selection.
steps.healthy_condition: Your report matches the screen’s visible green container/total ID and the cell’s dark-blue vs light-blue indicator; tote number is included when the box icon is shown after selection.
steps.failure_condition: Your interpretation does not align with the visible green container/total ID or the visible dark-blue vs light-blue indicator on the screen.

actions.label: Provide interpretation
actions.exact_action: Use the observed container/total ID and tote-present/empty meaning to report what the screen indicates for that location.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the screen does not show the expected container/total ID or the color indicator meaning cannot be applied, stop and escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Green “113” is the container/total ID; dark blue indicates tote presence while light blue represents empty rack; selecting shows box icon and tote number.

success_criteria: You correctly identify the green container/total ID value on the Container Selection screen (example “113”).
You correctly classify the rack/location as tote-present (dark blue) vs empty rack (light blue).
When selecting a tote-present (dark-blue) cell, the box icon appears and the tote number is displayed.
healthy_conditions: Green container/total ID is visible and readable.
Dark-blue vs light-blue indicators match the described tote-present vs empty rack meaning.
Selecting a tote-present cell reveals a box icon and tote number.
failure_conditions: Green container/total ID is not visible or cannot be read.
Dark-blue vs light-blue indicators do not match the described tote-present vs empty rack meaning.
Selecting a tote-present cell does not show a box icon and tote number.
escalation_guidance: If the screen does not show the expected container/total ID in green or the dark-blue vs light-blue meaning cannot be applied (e.g., colors/states differ from the described mapping), stop and escalate for clarification.
